description: This file defines a enum 'GatewayLaunchAgentManager' that manages launchd agents on macOS, providing functionalities to enable, disable, check status, restart, and configure the launch agent related to the gateway daemon. It also handles launching commands, parsing daemon JSON responses, and managing launch agent plist snapshots.

classes.name: GatewayLaunchAgentManager
classes.description: A static utility enum providing methods to manage macOS launch agents for the gateway daemon, including enabling/disabling, checking status, restarting, and snapshotting configuration.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the launch agent write is disabled by the presence of a marker file.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Creates or removes the disable marker file to toggle write permissions for the launch agent.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if the daemon is loaded via launchd.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on parameters, skipping if in remote mode or if write is disabled.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the launch agent's configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Determines the log path for the launch daemon, based on snapshot or fallback.
